title: Additive structure functions and restriction on the small etale site
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], let A_X be the sheaf on its small etale site whose value on V is ULift of the additive group of Gamma(V,O_V). Its restriction maps are pullbacks of functions. Explicitly compose X.etaleStructurePresheaf with the forgetful functors CommRingCat to RingCat to AddCommGrpCat and the additive universe lift. For a morphism g:X to Y define A_Y to g_* A_X [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] on V by pullback along V times_Y X to V. The sheaf property follows from the structure sheaf property; the definitions use the same pullback as the restriction of units [def-sc-gm-torsor].
